name: public-maintenance-new
js: const old = document.querySelector('[data-testid=maintenance-request-card]'); const card = old.cloneNode(true); card.querySelector('h3').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; card.querySelector('p').textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.'; const p = card.querySelector('.priority-badge'); p.className = 'priority-badge medium'; p.textContent = 'Medium'; card.querySelector('.request-date').textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026'; old.before(card);

name: admin-maintenance-detail-new
js: const old = document.querySelector('#mt-panel li.list__item'); const item = old.cloneNode(true); const a = old.querySelector('a.list__title'); a.removeAttribute('aria-current'); const t = item.querySelector('a.list__title'); t.textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; const m = item.querySelectorAll('.list__meta'); m[0].textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.'; m[1].textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM'; old.before(item); document.querySelector('#rq-title').textContent = 'Water under the kitchen sink'; document.querySelector('[role=tablist][aria-label="Kitchen tap leak"]').setAttribute('aria-label', 'Water under the kitchen sink'); const dd = document.querySelectorAll('#rq-panel dl dd'); dd[1].textContent = 'Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM'; dd[2].textContent = 'Medium'; document.querySelector('#rq-panel > p').textContent = 'There is a puddle under the sink every morning.';
